chapter: New York and the swing years
title: Recordings in New York with Red Allen and others
summary: In New York he recorded with Red Allen, Billy Banks, the Mound City Blue Blowers and Coleman Hawkins.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: I remember those records you made with, um, Red Allen.

Yeah, oh, Billy Banks, all the Dixieland group. I made a lot of recordings with them, and I played with some of the best bands in different combinations. Tommy Dossie, Mount, Mount City Blue Blows, Tommy Dossie, all those guys, Coleman Hawkins.
